exact_question: Under the pinned hillipop-ede_n3 source/configuration, the same fixed admitted common background and matched validated z=810 start state used by Q051, does the actual native CLASS/P6 low-z implementation produce q=xHeII=10^-6 versus q=0 electron-fraction and Thomson-optical-depth histories that are reproducible, trajectory-consistent with the literal source-real dynamics, and contained within Q051's uniform analytic bounds; and what are the realized sup|Delta x_e| and sup|Delta tau_T| with a validated numerical error certificate?
objective: Extend the conditional positive electron difference from the accepted V89 endpoint through the remaining common-HMLA phase-5 cells.
frozen: Same admitted B_star, matched z=810 start, pinned source, source enclosures, config, common H and q. No fit or model changes.

Apply the common-branch lower-face lemma from V85 with h=h_R, E=h_L-h_R+q and u=ln(811/(1+z)). On E=0, establish h>q, 0<v<=1 with the required strict upper bound, and checked inclusion in the inherited V77 rate and thermal domains.

Use temperature order only up to first contact. Check U_R,i>0, U_L,i<=(1-q/h)U_R,i, and positive HMLA C_i monotone in raw escape with shared background. Check positivity of q/h_upper as a bound on E_prime/abs(f_R), or rigorously exclude an empty face.

Give exact per-cell coverage and a separate check of the critical domain predicates and the block margin or first obstruction. Confirm allowed one-sided fields at junctions. Distinguish relaxed face examples from actual trajectories.
Join only the contiguous proven prefix. On success stop at z=50 and record the interface for possible phase-6 work.
success: All 1281 cells close with a continuous positive prefix to z=50 under the frozen premises.
failure_or_inconclusive: Name first specific unclosed inequality with cell, feasible box and source branch. Keep the previously certified prefix; a loose interval bound is not evidence of sign reversal.
stop_condition: First unresolved admissible cell, validated adverse witness, exact z=50 endpoint, or first prototype runtime limit.
